text.en:
This Order shall take effect as of September 22,
1950, the date Republic Act No. 588 took effect.

4682
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of October, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
